chapter: The union and the 1920s-30s band scene
title: Lloyd Reese, saxophonist, trumpeter and teacher
summary: Howard praises Lloyd Reese, recalls taking him on a Hollywood job in his band, and says he played both saxophone and trumpet.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel
